data.value:
SRP (typical market price when new): Approx. ₱8,900,000 – ₱13,000,000 (Varies heavily by year, trim, and market; current units often higher)
SPECS:
Overall Dimensions (mm): 4,710 × 1,895 × 1,370 Wheelbase (mm): 2,780 Seating Capacity: 4
ENGINE / PERFORMANCE
Engine:
3.8 L Twin-Turbo V6 (VR38DETT)
Maximum Output: ~565 hp (base models) Maximum Torque: ~633 Nm
Higher trims (NISMO versions):
Maximum Output: ~600 hp Maximum Torque: ~652 Nm
Transmission: 6-speed Dual-Clutch Automatic (rear-mounted transaxle) Drivetrain: ATTESA E-TS All-Wheel Drive (AWD)
Performance: 0–100 km/h: ~2.7–3.0 seconds (variant-dependent) Top Speed: ~315 km/h
CAPACITY & CAPABILITIES
Towing Capacity: Not rated; supercar, not a hauler
Payload Capacity: Approx. 350–380 kg
Fuel Tank Capacity: 74 L
INTERIOR / CABIN / SPACE
Seating: 2+2 configuration (rear seats are small)
Infotainment: Performance display system + multimedia head unit Speakers: Premium Bose audio system (varies by trim)
CHASSIS / BRAKES / WHEELS / SUSPENSION
Front Brake / Rear Brake: High-performance ventilated disc brakes (Brembo)
Suspension: Bilstein DampTronic adjustable suspension system
Tires / Wheels: 20” Alloy Wheels with performance tires Wide staggered setup (front narrower, rear wider)
Ground Clearance: Approx. 110 mm
